Class Ghost

java.lang.Object
petgame.Pet
petgame.Ghost
public class Ghost extends Pet
This class represents the ghost pet that is used by the player. It tracks the pets different states, and updates the stats accordingly.
Author:
Rushd Alashqar 251377969 and Braeden Patierno-Barker 251382353
